arguments.command:
cd /workspace/task && md5sum scratch/log.jsonl && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json
codes=[];invalid=[]
with open('scratch/log.jsonl','rb') as f:
    data=f.read()
text=data.decode('utf-8')
lines=text.split('\n')
if lines and lines[-1]=='': lines=lines[:-1]
for i,l in enumerate(lines,1):
    if l.strip()=='' : continue
    try:
        o=json.loads(l)
    except Exception:
        invalid.append(i); continue
    if isinstance(o,dict) and o.get('level')=='error':
        codes.append(o.get('code'))
out={"codes":codes,"invalid_lines":invalid}
with open('scratch/errors.json','w',encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump(out,f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
    f.write('\n')
EOF
cat scratch/errors.json; md5sum scratch/log.jsonl
